run.scope: Independent Grok re-audit of the entropy/RNG path feeding BIP-39 mnemonic and key generation in src/keys/ at commit fc88144f. In scope: CSPRNG selection, CryptoRng bound on generate_with_aux_rand, entropy sizing. NOT in scope: descriptor parsing, PSBT, chain sync, FFI, correctness of upstream rand/bip39 crates. Cross-model counterpart to OSC-2026-0002.

findings.summary: No CSPRNG-selection defects found in BIP-39/key generation. GeneratableKey::generate_with_aux_rand requires impl CryptoRng + RngCore (src/keys/mod.rs:642-644), fills entropy via rng.fill_bytes, then generate_with_entropy. Default generate() uses bitcoin::key::rand::thread_rng() (mod.rs:636). BIP-39 Mnemonic uses Entropy = [u8; 32] and slices to word_count/8 before Mnemonic::from_entropy_in (bip39.rs:138-146). No silent weak-PRNG fallback; type system rejects non-CryptoRng RNGs. Cross-model agreement with OSC-2026-0002.
